name: Aurangzaib Shehzad Awan
title: GenAI Engineer (Agentic Systems)
bio: GenAI Engineer specializing in multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines, and production-ready LLM applications. Experienced in building and deploying intelligent systems using modern LLM frameworks and MLOps tooling.

education.institution: FAST National University of Computer and Emerging Sciences (NUCES)

bullets: Built a multi-agent conversational system for a high-end fashion brand: a browser agent handling routine product and catalog queries, and a case-solver agent handling complex, high-caliber requests.
Defined the routing logic between agents so query complexity determined which agent handled the request, keeping simple lookups cheap and reserving deeper reasoning for hard cases.
Engineered a token-optimization strategy for prompt construction, cutting LLM token usage and inference cost, and introduced multithreading to improve pipeline throughput.
Built a web application with FastAPI and React, containerized it with Docker, and deployed it serverlessly on AWS Lambda.

projects.name: MentorAI
projects.subtitle: FYP - AI skill-mentor and proctoring system
bullets: Engineered a stateful AI agent using LangGraph and Gemini/Groq LLMs that analyzes a user's skill profile from the database and recommends personalized real-world projects to build.

Developed a real-time anti-cheating proctoring system combining YOLOv8n (multi-face and phone detection) with MediaPipe (gaze tracking, head pose, posture analysis) running concurrently on live webcam streams.

projects.name: AI Assistant
projects.subtitle: This agent — a LangGraph-powered talking resume
bullets: Built this multi-node LangGraph agent — classify, github-fetch, and qa nodes — that routes visitor questions and answers as a talking resume.
Persists conversation history in Postgres via a custom message-log table, deployed on Vercel with Neon as the database.

projects.name: AI Stylist
projects.subtitle: Multi-Agent Assistant for a High-End Fashion Brand
projects.note: Client project - code is private and the product never went live publicly, so there is no repo to share.
bullets: Designed the relational schema behind the LangGraph-orchestrated agent flow, modelling the product catalog and conversation state so both agents could query it directly.
Wrote the ORM layer that exposed the schema to the agents as structured query interfaces instead of raw SQL, keeping data access consistent across agent flows.
Scraped the client's full website with Playwright and built the cleaning and normalization pass that turned raw pages into the structured dataset the agents retrieve over.

projects.name: Multimodal RAG
projects.subtitle: Document QA System
projects.note: Local only - not yet pushed to GitHub.
bullets: Built a multimodal RAG pipeline retrieving over both text and images, using a vision-language model (VLM) to interpret figures alongside font-aware text extracted via PyMuPDF4LLM and embedded images via fitz.
Implemented recursive chunking and hybrid retrieval (dense + sparse embeddings) on Qdrant to improve recall and ranking over dense-only search.

projects.name: LLaMA 3.1 8B Fine-Tuning
projects.subtitle: Text-to-SQL
bullets: Fine-tuned LLaMA 3.1 8B on the Spider Text-to-SQL dataset using QLoRA (4-bit quantization) on Kaggle GPUs.
Applied PEFT via LoRA adapters for parameter-efficient fine-tuning, tracking experiments and metrics with MLflow.
